text.textPath: The Cisterns of the Buried Leper Prince

svg.text: Five levels deep, four ways down, one loop between levels and two within levels

Each level is a cutaway slice of earth; front walls removed. One flagstone is about 5 ft. Lettered diamonds mark where each way between levels starts (↓) and arrives (↑); loop ways close the loops as alternative routes, shortcuts, dangerous paths or one-way drops.
